author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
Tolkien’s balrogs went through numerous tweaks over his years of writing, with some changes coming after we met Durin’s Bane in The Fellowship of the Ring! We cover this evolution, including how many balrogs there were!

Hit subscribe and the bell for great Tolkien content every week!
